kind: Prospective GRPO/RLOO/KTO estimator and interface study
boundary: Prepared tokenizer/data spans only; no model scoring, generation or optimizer execution.

exact_study.reward: one if candidate equals gold, else zero
exact_study.target: three-candidate-logit gradient of restricted-policy expected reward
exact_study.selection: all32 fixed records, no checkpoint selection

online.reward: strict retained label match; validity and EOS separate

kto.ordering: source ID then fixed candidate order
kto.reference: actual native cyclic mismatch within microbatch4, detached mean clamp

scratch.prompt_order: torch.randperm of16 sorted records after model loading, no replacement for2steps

evaluation.inference_claim: two updates are interface observations, not convergence or superiority
